title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. ~595–601 in Grothendieck's own numbering; the archive number is 593). Grothendieck is studying automorphisms u of a profinite group of SL2(Z)-type (pi-hat), presented by two torsion elements rho and sigma. Their 'lacets' L_rho ≅ Z/6 and L_sigma ≅ Z/4 are the finite stabilizers, as in SL2(Z) = Z/6 *_{Z/2} Z/4. Each u in M[Gamma_0] (= M^![0] = Z^!_{rho,sigma}) acts by u(rho) = int(alpha)·rho^{chi}, for an element alpha that is determined only up to the central sign ±1 (the image of -1 in SL2). The previous page explains that this sign ambiguity is exactly the residual extension So^pi Gamma^!_{rho,sigma} of Z^!_{rho,sigma} by mu = {±1}. Grothendieck removed the ambiguity by the normalization alpha ∈ Pi-hat_{0,2} (= F-hat_{{1,2}}·pi-hat_3).

This page shows that this normalization is not multiplicative. For u'' = u'u with normalized alpha, alpha', alpha'' one always has alpha'' = eps·alpha'·alpha with eps ∈ {±1}, by the a priori ambiguity (60). A proposition from his p.598 gives the exact sign. Writing eps_2(u) and eps_3(u) for the ±1-valued characters giving the action of u on the 2-part and 3-part of the lacets (mod-4 and mod-3 cyclotomic-type characters):
- eps = +1 iff eps_3(u) = 1 or eps_2(u')eps_3(u') = 1;
- eps = -1 iff eps_3(u) = -1 and eps_2(u')eps_3(u') = -1.

In modern terms, the normalized section u ↦ alpha(u) has a sign 2-cocycle c(u',u) = x(u')·y(u) with values in F_2, where x = [eps_2 eps_3 = -1] and y = [eps_3 = -1]. This is a non-symmetric bilinear form on the quotient (Z/2)^2. Its class is nonzero, and the corresponding central extension of (Z/2)^2 by Z/2 is dihedral of order 8. The page ends by starting a Corollary that restates this in terms of the elements a ∈ N_rho, with a = eps_3(tau')·alpha^{-1}·u (continued on the next page as (61)–(64)). The next page also finds the correct twisted multiplication law alpha'' = eps·u'(alpha)·alpha' times a commutator correction.

Purpose: to compute exactly the central extension by ±1 governing the lift from PSL2-type data (pi-hat/±1) to SL2-type data in his analysis of automorphisms satisfying the 'équation des lacets' (a GT-like setting).
errors: Slip on the page: the 'cas contraire' is written 'eps_2(u')eps_3(u') = +1'. Logically, and as stated in (63) on the next page, it should be -1.
In (59 bis), the superscript on eps_2 (read as eps_2^2) is a stray mark or misreading. Read literally, eps_2^2 = 1 and the condition would be wrong. Next page confirms it means eps'_2 eps'_3 = 1.
The p.598 cross-reference is in Grothendieck's own pagination, not the archive pagination.

ideas.what: The normalized lift alpha ∈ Pi-hat_{0,2} of the conjugating element is not multiplicative; its defect is an explicit ±1 2-cocycle, bilinear in two sign characters (eps_3 of the right factor, eps_2·eps_3 of the left factor).
ideas.modern_name: Explicit 2-cocycle of a central extension by {±1} (lifting from PSL2 to SL2 data; class of a D4-type extension of (Z/2)^2)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard group cohomology; the specific sign computation for profinite SL2(Z)/GT-type automorphisms is not attributed to anyone in particular

ideas.what: Interpreting the residual extension So^pi Gamma by mu as the sign ambiguity in choosing alpha over its image in pi-hat/±1.
ideas.modern_name: Central extension SL2 → PSL2 restricted to the automorphism/normalizer setting (cf. lifting GT-hat actions to SL2(Z)-hat)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore; related work by Lochak–Schneps, Ihara, Nakamura on the action of GT-hat on SL2(Z)-hat-type groups
ideas.where_published: Possibly touched on in La Longue Marche à travers la théorie de Galois (1981), unsure

missed.claim: An explicit sign cocycle for normalized lifts in the SL2 versus PSL2 version of the 'équation des lacets' setting. It is a small technical detail, unlikely to be absent from any careful modern treatment of lifting GT-hat actions to SL2(Z)-hat.
missed.quote: on trouve maintenant que ε=+1 ssi on est dans le cas (59 bis), −1 dans le cas contraire i.e. si ε3(u)=−1 et ε2(u')ε3(u')=+1
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Marginal. It gives an explicit description of the ±1 central extension one meets when passing from PSL2(Z)-hat to SL2(Z)-hat in GT-type computations.

deep.surprise_reason: A routine technical sign computation (a 2-cocycle bookkeeping step) inside a long working calculation, containing a small slip. No new concept or connection.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'convenique' should be 'commode' ('pour commode qu'il soit').
Line 4: 'normali-convenique' should be 'normalisés' ('(normalisés par la condition α'' ∈ Π̂_{0 2})').
'verrons de constater' should probably be 'venons de constater'.
Page number at foot: 593 is the archive pagination; Grothendieck's own number is likely 600, so the previous page '500' is probably 599.
